messages:
alice_support: FYI — AcmeHealth reporting sustained 429s for their Dedicated pool in eu-west1 since ~08:10 UTC. Customer on a reserved contract, escalated to support.
ben_sre: seeing placement failures in the control plane logs for eu-west1. Errors show GPU_STOCKOUT and placement_timeouts.
carla_runtime: confirmed. Autoscaler logs show aggressive scale-down followed by rapid scale-ups -> thrash. Some hosts evicting smaller tenants under pressure.
dan_prodops: any noisy-tenant signals? I can see one job from tenant 'ml-training-42' using sustained 90% GPU for 18+ hours.
emma_solutions: customer says latency spikes when requests fall back to us-west2. They reported >1.2s tail latency and some billing alerts for cross-region egress.
frank_account: looping in AM — Acme wants ETA and mitigation. They're worried about SLA credits if this persists. Please prioritize.
alice_support: reproducer attached by customer: curl to our Dedicated endpoint returns 429 with JSON:
```
{ "error": "placement_failed", "reason": "GPU_STOCKOUT", "retry_after": 60 }
```
ben_sre: stack snippet from control plane at 08:11:
```
placement_manager.go:456 handlePlacement: placement failed: stockout(region=eu-west1, pool=dedicated-prod, available=0)
autoscaler.go:213 scaleDown: marked node n-123 for termination
```
carla_runtime: looks like autoscaler policy min=2, targetUtil=0.6, but with sudden drop in active pods it trimmed then couldn't satisfy surge requests. We should tune cooldown and scale-up step for Dedicated pools.
dan_prodops: immediate mitigation options: 1) temporarily extend fallback window to prefer local region for pinned customers, 2) pause scale-down cooldown, 3) force-add reserved instances to eu-west1.
emma_solutions: customer wants option (3) now if possible. Any way to borrow capacity from reserved-na or burst pool?en_sre: we can reassign a small reserve from global-burst if we mark overflow as best-effort. That will reduce their failovers but could raise cost.
frank_account: Acme approves best-effort borrow for next 6 hours; wants us to escalate postmortem and compensation if SLA breached.
deploy_bot: @carla_runtime triggered capacity reassign job: job-7834 queued -> moving 2 GPUs from global-burst to eu-west1-dedicated.
carla_runtime: provisioning looks in progress. Also proposing throttling low-priority queues (batch jobs) to free GPU cycles. I can push a policy patch: set tenant 'ml-training-42' max_share=0.5 for 2h.
alice_support: Customer reports a drop in 429s after 08:22 UTC but occasional 503s during heavy spikes. Still seeing higher than normal latency for failovers.
ben_sre: adding diagnostics: adding a short-term placement override so pinned customers get priority. Created ticket INFRA-5489 (P1) assigned to eng-runtime and capacity team.
dan_prodops: post-action plan: adjust autoscaler cooldown to 300s, max scale-up step to +6 nodes, and add grace window to avoid thrash. Will schedule a config push today.
carla_runtime: runtime patch ready: change scaleDownStabilization=600s for Dedicated pools and increase prefix cache to reduce request latency during failovers. Rolling canary to 10% now.
emma_solutions: I told Acme we'll provide a status update and ETA for full remediate in 4 hours. Also offered temporary routing to hosted tier until eu-west1 stability confirmed.
frank_account: logging customer acceptance for hosted fallback. Keep AM looped.
alice_support: action items summary: (1) borrowed 2 GPUs from global-burst (done) (2) throttled noisy tenant ml-training-42 (in progress) (3) INFRA-5489 created (P1) (4) runtime config canary rolling (carla) (5) notify customer every 30m. I'll post updates here.
ben_sre: quick note on root cause hypothesis: reserved pool sizing + aggressive autoscaler config + a long-running noisy tenant caused temporary stockout -> placement failures -> cross-region failover -> perceived latency and billing spikes.
dan_prodops: long-term: increase eu-west1 reserve by 10% for Dedicated, add autoscaler safeguard preventing scale-down below surge buffer, and implement noisy-tenant detection with auto-throttle.
alice_support: thanks all. I'll send the 08:40 UTC update to Acme now. If anything else changes ping here.
frank_account: keeping customer on a brief hold but they're appreciative of quick action. :thumbsup:
carla_runtime: can we capture a short postmortem with timeline + config diffs once stabilized? I'll draft.
alice_support: agreed. Closing for now but will append final notes in INFRA-5489 postmortem.
